name: Peter Hughes
headline: Senior HVAC Design Engineer
summary: Chartered building-services engineer with 11 years designing heating, ventilation and cooling for hospitals, schools and offices. I specialise in airflow and energy modelling for low-carbon refurbishments.

experience.title: Senior HVAC Design Engineer
bullets: Lead ventilation design for NHS hospital refurbishments worth 40 million pounds, including operating-theatre airflow and pressure cascades.
Modelled airflow and heat loads for 25 schools moving from gas boilers to heat pumps.
Built the team's Excel sizing workbooks for ductwork and fans, now the standard on every project.
Review contractors' commissioning results and sign off airflow rates against the design.

experience.title: HVAC Design Engineer
bullets: Designed heating and ventilation for office fit-outs from 2,000 to 30,000 square metres.
Ran airflow and thermal comfort checks in Excel and produced the schedules for tender packages.
Surveyed existing plant rooms and wrote condition reports for landlords.

hobbies: Python scripting for a Raspberry Pi weather station
